To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most common strategic approach to sustainability in the fashion supply chain management is the “green” approach.
the main strategic approaches are (1) the use of sustainability certifications and (2) the use of social and environmental audits.

“the main strategic approaches to supply chain sustainability in fashion are: the adoption of a green supply chain management approach; the adoption of a social responsible approach; and the integration of both approaches in a holistic approach”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the strategic approaches to sustainability in the fashion SCM and with investigating the factors that affect their implementation.
understanding what strategic approaches to sustainability exist in the fashion supply chain.
identifying and analysing the main strategic approaches that fashion companies can adopt in order to achieve sustainability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the strategic approaches used by fashion companies are still in the initial stages, but they are moving in the right direction.
the most effective strategic approach to sustainability in fashion SCM is the one that combines the best practices of all the approaches identified in this research.
the fashion supply chain is characterised by a wide variety of sustainability practices, and these are often driven by a mix of factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sustainability practices can be categorised into four different strategic approaches to SCM: (1) green, (2) social, (3) integrated, and (4) collaborative.
sustainability is a complex and multi-faceted issue that requires a holistic view of the supply chain, and a multi-stakeholder perspective.
sustainability can be achieved by implementing different approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the sustainability approaches in fashion SCM can be classified into three categories: (i) the “sustainable product approach” that focuses on the product’s sustainability; (ii) the “green supply chain approach” that focuses primarily on the supply chain management process and (iii) the “sustainability management system approach” that focuses more on the sustainability management process.
the sustainability challenge in fashion SCM can be addressed in three main approaches.
sustainability is a multifaceted issue that needs to be addressed by a wide range of strategic approaches.
